title: Alternative Adventure
description: Mod that is an alternate timeline mod for Beta 1.7.3! Shows what if instead of Adventure Update devs added something different...
body:
Minecraft Alternative Adventure (AltAdv) is what Minecraft could've been if Mojang haven't released Adventure Update, and instead kept Beta style and world generation.

**Recommended to use MultiMC or Prism to load a mod. AltAdv is jar mod which is loaded by using Add to minecraft.jar function in MultiMC or Prism.**

Mod overhauls b1.7.3 by fixing some of bugs and by adding some Qol features:
- **Improved boats.** Boats now are faster, drop themselves and don't break when collides with blocks/entities.
- **Improved tools.** Axes and Pickaxes now break all blocks that they supposed to break faster correctly.
- **Fixed recipes.** Fixed fences, slabs, signs and other recipes to be more like in modern MC.
- **Fixed food.** Food is no longer can be eaten when a player has full health, also food is now stackable up to 64.
- **Fixed fences.** Now can be placed whatever you want they to be.
- **Zombies drop nothing.** Zombies no longer drop feathers.
- **Snowy leaves.** Leaves now turn white in snowy biomes.
- **Fixed stairs.** Now drop themselves.
- **Editable signs.** Can be edited like in 1.20 and later versions.
- **Sheeps regrow their wool.** Sheeps automatically regrow their wool with time.

Besides that, mod adds a missing blocks, items and completely new stuff:
- **Missing blocks/items.** Redstone, coal, smoothstone, smooth sandstone, missing stairs and slabs, music discs from Adventure Update, faceless pumpkins and birch/spruce blocks and items are added.
- **New flowers.** Implemented blue roses and paeonias, they are used to craft light blue and pink dyes.
- **New achievements.** Only 2 so far, but later there'll be more.
- **Stone bricks.** Added stone bricks from b1.8 and its variations.
- **Glowing obsidian.** Found in the Nether, can be used for decorations. Does not burn in lava/fire like netherite from 1.16.
- **Shrubs.** Added shrubs to Shrubland biome.
- **Unused Paintings.** Brought back 4 unused paintings from Pocket Edition.

 Also a few general additions are made:
- **Polished title screen.** Random bg instead of default dirt one.
- **Additions to F3 screen.** Seed and biome can be seen using F3.
- **Map shows position.** F3 screen no longer shows coordinates, in order to see your coordinates you need to craft map.
- **Better 3-rd person.** Third-person is now accessed via Numpad 0, 1 and 2 keys. 0 is first-person, 1 is second-person and 2 is third-person.

**Decsription changelog is only accurate for 1.0 version. Later changes will be in changelog page.**
